title: Cornelius, 41
body: Fourth generation corn farmer. My great-grandmother invented the corn dog (unverified). I speak to my corn daily. They speak back (also unverified). Looking for someone who understands that corn isn't just a crop, it's a lifestyle.
summary: Fourth generation corn farmer. Speaks to his corn daily. Maximum corn score.

prompts.question: My ideal first date involves...
prompts.answer: A sunset walk through my cornfields. I'll introduce you to my favorites. Gerald is the tall one on the left. He's shy at first.

prompts.question: I'm passionate about...
prompts.answer: Corn-based everything. Corn syrup, corn starch, corn bread, corn on the cob, baby corn, popcorn, candy corn (controversial, I know).

prompts.question: The way to my heart is...
prompts.answer: Show genuine interest in corn. Ask me about heirloom varieties. Compliment my stalks. That's not a euphemism. Or is it? It's not. Unless...
